items.title: Enterprise Software & Internal Systems
items.description: Spreadsheet migrations, custom ERPs, and complete control over inventory, purchasing, and sales.
items.longDescription: We design and build enterprise platforms that replace scattered Excel sheets and costly off-the-shelf software. We centralize inventory, sales, purchasing, finance, and HR into a secure, fast, and accessible system.
highlights: Full spreadsheet migration to a secure database
Integrated inventory, purchasing, and sales control
Granular employee roles and custom permissions
24/7 cloud access from mobile and desktop

items.title: AI Implementation for Business
items.description: 24/7 intelligent assistants, automated invoice extraction, and custom AI automation grounded in your actual data.
items.longDescription: We integrate cutting-edge language models and private models grounded on your company manuals, catalogs, and policies. Accurate answers grounded in your documents, automated data extraction, and computer vision.
highlights: 24/7 customer support with your real knowledge base (RAG)
Automated data extraction from invoices and PDFs
Audio transcription and meeting minutes
Computer vision and automated quality control

items.title: Web & Mobile App Development
items.description: Sub-second load websites that convert visitors, payment gateways, and mobile apps for iOS and Android.
items.longDescription: We build modern digital experiences, ranging from high-conversion landing pages to full SaaS platforms and mobile apps on iOS and Android with single-codebase efficiency.
highlights: Fast loading optimized for every screen
iOS and Android mobile apps in Flutter and React
Payment checkout integration (Stripe, cards, bank transfers)
Engineered for high search engine visibility (SEO)

items.title: Cybersecurity & Tech Advisory
items.description: Hardening for existing software, vulnerability auditing, automated offsite backups, and bank-grade data encryption.
items.longDescription: Digital security is essential to safeguard your business from ransomware, database breaches, and regulatory fines. We audit existing systems, shield APIs, and advise leadership before major technical investments.
highlights: Security auditing and hardening for existing systems
Bank-grade encryption for credentials and records
Automated offsite disaster recovery backups
Honest senior tech consultation before investing

items.title: UI/UX Design & User Experience
items.description: Intuitive software that needs no manual, clickable prototypes before coding, and mobile-first ergonomic layouts.
items.longDescription: Great design makes complex software feel effortless. We build interactive Figma prototypes so you can test user flows before writing code, ensuring frictionless conversions and brand consistency.
highlights: Interactive prototypes to test before coding
Intuitive flows that reduce customer support tickets
Ergonomic single-handed mobile design
Scalable design systems and brand consistency

items.title: Automation, Analytics & Reporting
items.description: WhatsApp automation, multi-tool API connections, manual task elimination, and live executive dashboards.
items.longDescription: We bridge your business tools into seamless automated workflows. We connect your store with WhatsApp, payment gateways, electronic invoicing, and inventory so sales process automatically with real-time KPI visibility.
highlights: Automated WhatsApp notifications and confirmations
Elimination of repetitive manual data entry
Real-time revenue and sales performance dashboards
Multi-tool connection using APIs and Webhooks

privacy.title: Comprehensive privacy notice
privacy.intro: At Symmetrical Code we take care of the data you share with us. This notice explains what data we process, why, where it is stored, and how you can exercise your rights.

blocks.text: Patricio Antonio García Pérez Vela, Mario Jesús Delgado Hernández and Eduardo Estrada Estrada, who operate under the trade name Symmetrical Code, are the controllers responsible for processing your personal data.
Contact email: {{email}}.

We only process the data you decide to share with us when you write to us on WhatsApp or by email: name, phone number, email address, your company's name (if you share it), and the project information you include in the conversation. We do not request sensitive personal data; please do not send it in your messages. Browsing the site also generates technical visit data, described in section 6.

We use your data to: (a) respond to your inquiries; (b) prepare and send you quotes; (c) coordinate, develop, and follow up on the projects you contract with us. All of these purposes are necessary to handle your request or the service relationship you establish with us. We do not use your data for advertising, newsletters, or promotions. If we ever wanted to, we would update this notice and ask for your consent beforehand.

sections.title: Where your data is stored and who else is involved

blocks.text: We do not keep client or prospect databases. Your data lives only:

items: in WhatsApp conversations, a Meta service. When you write to us on WhatsApp, your communication is also governed by WhatsApp's privacy notice;
in our email: {{email}} is a forwarding address managed by our domain provider, Porkbun, to the controllers' personal mailboxes.

blocks.text: These providers, some located outside Mexico, process the information only to provide their service. We do not sell, rent, or transfer your data to third parties for their own purposes; we would only share it if a competent authority requires it by law.

We keep your conversations for as long as necessary to handle your request or your project, and for as long as applicable legal obligations require. You can ask us to delete them at any time (section 7).

sections.title: Technologies in your browser and analytics

blocks.text: This site does not use cookies. We use:

items: browser local storage (localStorage) to remember your light or dark theme and your language;
session storage (sessionStorage) so the WhatsApp notice does not repeat during your visit;

Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights, which measure visits and performance in an aggregated, cookieless way: they identify the visit with a value calculated from the request, which is discarded after 24 hours and cannot identify you.

blocks.text: The site is hosted on Vercel, which processes technical connection data, such as the IP address, to deliver and protect the site. You can clear local storage from your browser settings.

sections.title: ARCO rights and withdrawal of consent

blocks.text: You can access, rectify, or cancel your data, or object to its processing (ARCO rights), or withdraw your consent, by writing to {{email}}. Your request must include:

items: your name and a way to respond to you;
a document proving your identity or, where applicable, your representative's;
a clear description of the data and the right you want to exercise;
anything that helps us locate your data.

blocks.text: We will respond within a maximum of 20 business days and, if applicable, make it effective within the following 15 business days after our response. These periods may be extended once for an equal period when the case justifies it.

sections.title: How to limit the use of your data

blocks.text: You can ask us at any time to stop contacting you or to delete your conversation, by email to {{email}} or in the same WhatsApp chat.
We will publish any changes on this page along with its update date. If a change involves new purposes, we will inform you through the channel you used to contact us.

If you believe your right to personal data protection has been violated, you can turn to the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno (Mexico's data protection authority), the competent authority on the matter.
